story.originalTitle: At least we got a podium. Our pace and consistency weren’t where we wanted it to be, lots to learn from. Great to see so much support out here this w...
story.summaryEn:
At least we got a podium. Our pace and consistency weren’t where we wanted it to be, lots to learn from.
Great to see so much support out here this weekend. Thank you Austin 🙌
detailZh:
至少我们获得了领奖台。我们的速度和稳定性并没有达到我们想要的水平，有很多东西可以学习。
很高兴看到这个周末有这么多的支持。感谢Austin 🙌
detailEn:
At least we got a podium. Our pace and consistency weren’t where we wanted it to be, lots to learn from.
Great to see so much support out here this weekend. Thank you Austin 🙌

relatedItems.summaryZh: 阿隆索在墨西哥大奖赛期间因未正确安装方向盘被FIA记录为一般安全事件。

detailZh: 我们再次绿灯。阿隆索在墨西哥大奖赛期间因未正确安装方向盘被FIA记录为一般安全事件。
